claim: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.
The Eiffel Tower was completed as the entrance arch to the 1889 World's Fair in Paris.
The Eiffel Tower is 450 metres tall.
The Eiffel Tower was designed by Gustave Eiffel himself.
The 1889 World's Fair marked the 100th anniversary of the storming of the Bastille.
The 1889 World's Fair attracted about 5 million visitors.
